Compare health system metrics across levels

Source: R/7_health_systems.R
calculate_health_system_comparison.Rd

Returns a merged dataset of health coverage and system metrics at district and admin level 1 for the latest year.

Usage

calculate_health_system_comparison(
  .data,
  admin1_coverage_data,
  admin2_coverage_data
)

Arguments

.data

A cd_data object containing raw health system inputs including year, population, and facility indicators.

admin1_coverage_data

A coverage data frame at admin level 1 (with year, adminlevel_1 and cov_* columns), such as the output of calculate_indicator_coverage() for admin_level = "adminlevel_1". Its latest year defines the year kept in the result.

admin2_coverage_data

A coverage data frame at district level (with year, adminlevel_1, district and cov_* columns), such as the output of calculate_indicator_coverage() for admin_level = "district".

Value

A data frame with admin level 1 and district metrics joined side by side for comparison.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core")
cache <- load_cache_data(path)
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
cache$set_national_estimates(list(sbr = 0.02))
cache$adjust_data()

comparison <- calculate_health_system_comparison(
  cache$adjusted_data,
  admin1_coverage_data = cache$indicator_coverage_admin1,
  admin2_coverage_data = cache$indicator_coverage_district
)
comparison[c("adminlevel_1", "district", "ad1_ratio_fac_pop", "dis_ratio_fac_pop")]
#> # A tibble: 47 × 4
#>    adminlevel_1 district      ad1_ratio_fac_pop dis_ratio_fac_pop
#>    <chr>        <chr>                     <dbl>             <dbl>

#>  2 Central      Kirinyaga                  2.16              2.86
#>  3 Central      Laikipia                   2.16              1.91
#>  4 Central      Muranga                    2.16              1.96
#>  5 Central      Nyandarua                  2.16              2.03
#>  6 Central      Nyeri                      2.16              3.51
